title: Book Two · Chapter 57: The Price of One Morning
story:
On Sunday, Ronan takes the cost paper from his savings tin. He brings it to the kitchen table. Dad looks at the old numbers. Mum opens her notebook.

“Can we look again?” Ronan asks.

“Yes,” Mum says. “I asked about one morning. There is a place next month.”

Ronan sits down very quickly.

“One morning at Leo's reading room?”

“Yes. One visit. We can pay for that. We cannot promise every Saturday.”

Dad points to the travel cost. “This part is still here.”

“I can walk.”

“It is too far for you to go alone,” Mum says. “And I still need time for my work.”

Ronan puts his hands under the table. He wants to say that Leo goes every week. He looks at the numbers instead.

“Who will take me?”

“I can take you that morning,” Mum says. “Dad can collect you after work.”

“Will you lose a job?”

“I can move one collection to the afternoon. The customer agreed.”

She puts one finger on the day in her notebook. There is a small mark beside it. Another day has three marks.

Ronan reads the cost paper again. The visit is real, but it is only one visit. He feels happy and a little angry at the same time. He wants to feel happier about it.

“Can I buy the next one?” he asks.

Dad looks at the tin. “We can count your savings. But keep some for your own small needs. You do not have to spend it all today.”

They count the coins on a cloth. Ronan can pay for part of another morning. But he cannot pay the whole cost. He needs travel money too. He puts the coins back.

Mum writes the new plan on the back of the old paper. One visit. One day. No promise after that.

“Can I tell Leo?” Ronan asks.

“Yes.”

He folds the paper and returns it to the tin. The tin goes back on the shelf.

Later, he finds Leo by the small square. Leo is trying to keep a ball on one foot. The ball falls before Ronan reaches him.

“I can come once next month,” Ronan says.

Leo picks up the ball. “On my day?”

They check the day. It is the same morning. Leo grins. He passes the ball to Ronan.

“Then you can see my room.”

“The whole room?”

“Even the chairs.”

Ronan lifts the ball with his foot. It rolls away toward the wall. Both boys run after it before it reaches the path.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

morning＝上午；cost＝花费；promise＝承诺。

## 理解问题

1. 全家决定怎样参加活动？
2. 为什么不能自动续报？

## 读句子

**Mum / opens / her notebook.** Mum／翻开／她的记事本。
